modifications: The sign-up form is disabled in this copy (fields and submit button disabled, form action removed) so visitors to the archive cannot submit personal information. No text was changed.
Scripts are removed, including Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. The page was saved after the browser rendered it.

The page was captured with its "RSVP for Rally" pop-up open. Without scripts the pop-up cannot be closed, so it is hidden with CSS and the pop-up classes are removed from <body>. The pop-up stays in the HTML.
The header background video is saved in full (the first capture saved only its first bytes) and shown without the lazy-loading class that needed a script.
